scope.runtime_model: offline-authored trajectories evaluated from one global clock
source_precedence: CDOT highway geometry and traffic counts
City of Boulder street, lane, direction, speed, and signal authority
accepted product building, water, runway, sports-field, vegetation, median, and terrain masks

gate_policy.implementation_may_start_when: all validation methods have D_APPROVED status
phase_pass_requires: the independent validator reproduces every machine result
the lead inspects every required full-resolution image
no pass is inferred from aggregate route, vehicle, or test counts
gate_policy.failure_behavior: fail closed at the first unmet requirement; diagnose the first distinguishable contract failure before changing implementation

workstream_ownership.LEAD: shared schemas, architecture, integration, serialized product assets, builds, Git, and final acceptance

prohibited_runtime_behavior: per-vehicle GameObjects, Update methods, colliders, rigid bodies, or physics
random spawning, visible wrapping, teleportation, or identity mutation
per-eye LOD selection or head-facing eviction

requirements.user_visible_objective: Eligible roads throughout the flyable map carry plausible traffic rather than an airport- or City-only patch.
source_of_truth: independently acquired source inventories within the frozen 24 km square
source precedence and explicit eligibility/exclusion rules
requirements.validation_method: Independently reproject source centerlines, classify eligibility, intersect lane geometry with the frozen bounds, and compare represented lane-kilometers by road class and by benchmark viewport.
pass_thresholds: 100% of eligible motorway, trunk, primary, and secondary lane-kilometers represented
at least 95% of eligible tertiary and residential lane-kilometers represented
100% of roads visible from benchmark cameras classified
100% of the frozen +/-12 km bounds evaluated
every excluded road has an evidence-backed reason
requirements.failure_response: Stop source compilation; resolve the authority gap or explicitly exclude the ineligible feature. Never synthesize a road to satisfy coverage.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Every moving vehicle travels in the lawful direction on its lane.
requirements.validation_method: Reconstruct direction independently from source attributes and compare every directed edge plus sampled trajectory heading against its permitted lane direction.
pass_thresholds: zero wrong-way directed edges
zero wrong-way trajectory samples
zero unresolved pilot-visible direction conflicts
requirements.failure_response: Reject the edge and every dependent trajectory until its direction is corrected from source authority.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Opposing highway traffic remains on distinct, correctly oriented carriageways.
requirements.validation_method: Audit each divided-road lane against the independently reconstructed carriageway polygon and median barrier; sweep the complete vehicle footprint over every highway trajectory.
pass_thresholds: zero wrong-carriageway edges
zero artificial median crossings
zero carriageway merges lacking a source-backed legal junction
requirements.failure_response: Remove the invalid movement and recompile the carriageway geometry before routing resumes.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Complete vehicle footprints remain on paved traffic surfaces through lanes and turns.
requirements.validation_method: Use adaptive continuous swept-volume subdivision bounded by displacement and heading error, then independently test the swept polygon against the legal drivable surface.
pass_thresholds: at least 99.5% continuous swept-footprint containment at the lane-graph gate
100% containment for the final trajectory set and every pilot-visible movement
zero sampled footprint point more than 0.10 m outside the drivable surface at <=0.5 m witness spacing
zero unclosed visible joins
requirements.failure_response: Reject and regenerate the lane or trajectory; do not hide the violation with culling.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Vehicles never clip buildings, water, or medians.
requirements.validation_method: Independently rebuild exclusion polygons, apply conservative uncertainty buffers, and continuously intersect every rigid and articulated swept volume.
pass_thresholds: zero building intrusions
zero water intrusions
zero median intrusions
requirements.failure_response: Reject the dependent lane and trajectories until the authority or geometry is corrected.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Vehicles follow bridge decks and do not collide with terrain or traffic on another grade.
requirements.validation_method: Audit every crossing for layer assignment, compare road elevation to deck authority rather than bare earth, and suppress conflict zones between separated layers.
pass_thresholds: 100% of bridge and grade-separated edges have explicit layer and elevation authority
zero bare-earth snapping on known bridge decks
absolute deck-height error is at most 0.25 m against the pinned deck authority
zero collision reservations between geometrically crossing but grade-separated lanes
zero terrain or ground-clearance penetrations
requirements.failure_response: Exclude the unresolved structure from traffic and stop the source gate if it is pilot-visible or required for major-road continuity.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Vehicles make only legal, physically contained turns.
requirements.validation_method: Enumerate all authored turn arcs, independently derive permitted inbound/outbound pairs, and continuously sweep each supported vehicle class through its turn polygon.
pass_thresholds: zero illegal turns
zero artificial U-turn closures or straight-line joins
100% of turn arcs contained for every assigned vehicle class
requirements.failure_response: Remove the movement and every path using it until legal topology and containment both pass.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Signals, stops, yields, queues, and releases behave coherently without conflicts.
requirements.validation_method: Replay the full schedule through an independent reservation checker and verify controlled approaches, dwell, phase compatibility, queue order, and smooth entry/exit speeds.
pass_thresholds: zero overlapping conflict-zone reservations
zero movements during a conflicting red phase
100% stop-controlled movements satisfy their authored stop dwell
100% yield movements enter only with the required temporal clearance
requirements.failure_response: Reject the schedule at the first conflicting reservation and regenerate the affected intersection plan.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Highways and arterials look active while local streets remain plausibly intermittent across the complete map.
source_of_truth: road class, lanes, capacity, speed, land use, and freight relevance
requirements.validation_method: Recompute target directional flow independently, compare scheduled passage counts in rolling intervals, and audit pilot-visible occupancy by benchmark camera and flight path.
pass_thresholds: measured-count segments stay within the documented source uncertainty band
interpolated segments stay within their documented confidence interval
GEH is below 5 for at least 85% of calibrated directional screenlines and below 10 for 100%
aggregate directional flow is within +/-10% of the frozen calibrated target
all major-road benchmark views meet their source-derived visible-density band
residential occupancy is intermittent rather than uniform
no airport-only concentration and no performance-selected global density cap
requirements.failure_response: Correct demand evidence or scheduling; never lower semantic coverage to meet a render budget.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Ordinary views are passenger-dominant, with uncommon semis confined to credible freight movements.
requirements.validation_method: Audit class ratios globally, per context, within spatial neighborhoods, and in each benchmark viewport against the frozen source-derived target bands.
pass_thresholds: passenger cars, SUVs, and pickups form the largest combined class in every ordinary benchmark view
zero semis on residential paths
semi share on freight corridors remains within its evidence-derived band
each frozen light-vehicle archetype share is within +/-3 percentage points of its target and aggregate heavy/commercial share is within +/-2 points
source, demand, compiler, and runtime fleet weights are byte-for-byte consistent
every camera-specific class ratio remains within its frozen tolerance band
requirements.failure_response: Regenerate fleet assignments from the contextual distribution; do not hand-place exceptions.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Vehicles show natural speed variation, smooth braking, turning, and acceleration.
source_of_truth: speed limits and observed speed references
requirements.validation_method: Compare complete trajectory speed distributions and event derivatives with frozen class/road targets, including within-route variance and heavy-vehicle constraints.
pass_thresholds: every nontrivial road class has a nondegenerate source-derived speed distribution
the nonqueued empirical speed CDF has Kolmogorov-Smirnov D <= 0.10 against its frozen target and within-stratum coefficient of variation >= 0.05
zero instantaneous speed or acceleration discontinuities above the numeric interpolation tolerance
all acceleration, braking, and turn speeds remain within their driver/vehicle profile bounds
heavy-vehicle acceleration and turn-speed distributions are slower than passenger equivalents
requirements.failure_response: Regenerate the affected profile or trajectory; do not add runtime randomness.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Traffic forms irregular, safe gaps and signal-created platoons instead of an evenly spaced lattice.
requirements.validation_method: Measure time and distance headways by road class over the entire schedule, compare with frozen target distributions, and test for periodic spacing artifacts.
pass_thresholds: zero headways below the continuous collision-safe minimum
passenger desired time headways remain in [0.9, 2.2] seconds and heavy-vehicle desired headways remain in [1.4, 2.4] seconds unless the independently approved reference narrows those ranges
the empirical headway CDF has Kolmogorov-Smirnov D <= 0.10 against its frozen target
every populated road/class stratum contains at least three distinct persistent headway targets
each active major class has a nondegenerate headway distribution within its frozen target band
no statistically dominant fixed interval or repeated spatial lattice
queues preserve safe gaps through stop and release
requirements.failure_response: Regenerate demand arrivals or profiles while preserving calibrated flow.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Following vehicles never contact or pass through one another.
requirements.validation_method: Run an independent continuous-time broadphase and conservative OBB/articulated narrowphase for every co-lane pair over max(1800 seconds, two schedule periods), including stops and schedule boundaries, at authored interpolation precision plus 0.05 s and 0.20 s stress witnesses.
pass_thresholds: zero same-route collisions
zero interpenetrations
minimum same-route bumper clearance is at least 2.00 m at every continuous closest approach
requirements.failure_response: Reject and reschedule the colliding trajectories.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Vehicles on different routes never collide at intersections, merges, driveways, or crossings.
requirements.validation_method: Spatial-temporally index all swept volumes over max(1800 seconds, two schedule periods), independently narrowphase every overlapping candidate interval at authored precision plus 0.05 s and 0.20 s stress witnesses, and audit reservation ownership.
pass_thresholds: zero cross-route collisions
zero reservation conflicts
zero false conflicts between correctly separated grades
requirements.failure_response: Reject the first conflicting reservation set and regenerate the affected schedules.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Moving and parked vehicles remain physically distinct under runtime interpolation and streaming.
source_of_truth: accepted and reclassified parked oriented bounds
requirements.validation_method: Validate authored precision and runtime-decoded precision separately, then collide moving/moving and moving/parked OBBs over all resident cells and relevant times.
pass_thresholds: zero moving/moving overlap
zero moving/parked overlap
zero overlap introduced by trajectory compression or runtime interpolation
requirements.failure_response: Reject the trajectory, parked placement, or compression precision responsible for the first overlap.

requirements.user_visible_objective: A visible vehicle keeps the same model, paint, path, and identity across residency and LOD changes.
source_of_truth: persistent vehicle IDs and immutable appearance records
requirements.validation_method: Trace every benchmark-visible ID across time, cell transitions, pool pressure, and LOD transitions; compare immutable identity fields and transforms.
pass_thresholds: 100% unique persistent IDs
zero model or paint mutation for an ID
zero resolvable identity replacement during cell or capacity transitions
requirements.failure_response: Fail the runtime gate and correct residency/selection ownership rather than increasing churn tolerance.

requirements.user_visible_objective: The 15-minute repeat has no visible disappearance, wrap, reversal, or teleportation.
source_of_truth: valid map-boundary, destination, driveway, parking, occlusion, and unresolved-size portals
requirements.validation_method: Compare continuous state around t=0 and t=period for every vehicle, then replay all benchmark cameras across the boundary with visibility and projected-size instrumentation.
pass_thresholds: zero visible transform discontinuities and numerical seam position jump <=0.05 m
seam tangent/yaw discontinuity <=5 degrees and speed delta <=0.10 m/s
zero visible activation/deactivation events
zero path wrapping or reversal
every discontinuous inactive interval begins and ends only at a verified portal while unresolved or occluded
requirements.failure_response: Regenerate the schedule boundary or portal interval; never mask the event with a transparent fade.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Brief head turns do not make existing vehicles pop, disappear, or oscillate in detail.
requirements.validation_method: Replay deterministic 90-degree pans and rear glances under capacity pressure, holding aircraft state fixed, and diff per-ID existence/LOD traces plus full-resolution image sequences.
pass_thresholds: zero aircraft-corridor cell evictions caused solely by head direction
zero resolvable vehicle disappearances during a brief pan
zero one-frame LOD oscillations
zero head-only membership/tier changes for vehicles continuously visible inside a stable projected-size band and no A-B-A tier oscillation within 2 seconds
lead inspection finds no obvious transition in the full-resolution sequence
requirements.failure_response: Correct residency reservations or LOD hysteresis before adding capacity.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Both eyes see the same representation of every vehicle.
source_of_truth: maximum projected size across both OpenXR eyes
requirements.validation_method: Record left/right projected sizes and selected shared tier for each stereo-visible ID through head pans and cell transitions.
pass_thresholds: zero per-eye tier disagreements
100% of tier decisions use the maximum projected size across both eyes
inspected stereo captures show no eye-specific vehicle absence
requirements.failure_response: Fail the stereo gate and correct the shared-eye selection calculation.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Dense parking cannot erase moving traffic, and moving traffic cannot erase source-backed parked context.
source_of_truth: separate moving and parked minimum reservations
requirements.validation_method: Replay each benchmark with both candidate sets above capacity, assert category reservations before overflow borrowing, and compare visible inventories.
pass_thresholds: moving minimum reservation is met whenever enough resolvable moving candidates exist
parked minimum reservation is met whenever enough resolvable parked candidates exist
unused capacity may be borrowed but neither category silently consumes the other's reservation
every resolvable displaced detailed vehicle retains an appropriate lower LOD
requirements.failure_response: Correct pool partitioning and overflow accounting; do not tune a category score multiplier as a substitute.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Traffic is plausibly visible from the actual flight views where mapped roads can be resolved.
source_of_truth: frozen production-scene benchmark cameras and paths
requirements.validation_method: Count only projected, unoccluded vehicles in each frozen viewport over time, classify road/fleet context, and pair the audit with lead inspection of exact full-resolution images.
pass_thresholds: every benchmark-visible eligible major road meets its frozen viewport-density band
where a major road projects at least 2 pixels, at least one moving vehicle projects at least 2x2 pixels in 95% of benchmark frames
designated urban and pattern views contain at least five resolvable moving vehicles in 90% of benchmark frames, subject to their frozen count-derived upper band
every unexpectedly empty visible road is resolved or explicitly source-justified
pilot views are passenger-dominant and show no conspicuous local model/paint repetition
lead and D both approve the slice and full-map image evidence
requirements.failure_response: Correct demand, schedule, or residency at the first failed viewport; do not cite global totals.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Traffic remains visually stable without breaking the standalone Quest 3 72 Hz product target.
requirements.validation_method: Freeze traffic ceilings only after baseline capture, then audit static cost, steady-state allocations, resident-only trajectory sampling, immutable APK timing, stale/tear counts, thermals, and failures on the physical headset.
pass_thresholds: preserves 72 Hz on three exact-APK Quest 3 runs after 90 seconds warmup and 60 seconds traffic-stress measurement
average traffic-stress CPU and GPU frame time <=12.8 ms, p95 <=13.889 ms, over-budget frames <=5%, stale frames <=2, and tears=0
zero steady-state managed allocation attributable to traffic
zero per-vehicle GameObjects, Update methods, rigid bodies, or invisible-agent simulation
traffic draw, triangle, material, memory, and APK deltas stay within the frozen post-baseline budget
no traffic-attributable stutter at cell transitions
no thermal warning, crash, ANR, or OOM during the acceptance run
requirements.failure_response: Reduce mesh, decoding, compression, or scheduling cost without reducing semantic road coverage or visibly emptying roads.

requirements.user_visible_objective: Traffic V2 preserves the accepted aircraft, cockpit, XR, scenery, native JSBSim, controls, audio, and product hierarchy.
source_of_truth: fda11a2 dependency closure and serialized product scene
standard product validation, stereo simulator, Unity tests, and Android build
requirements.validation_method: Compare tracked paths and dependency closure against fda11a2, assert singleton XR/camera/aircraft/flight authority, inspect standard visual regressions, and run the complete product gate once after full-map acceptance.
pass_thresholds: zero out-of-scope product changes
exactly one enabled XR Origin, tracked OpenXR Main Camera, aircraft simulation root, and native JSBSim flight authority
zero UnityPrototype or rejected-candidate dependency closure
all focused and final product validators pass
all 123 standard Visual QA views are nonblank and inspected; masked nontraffic regions have SSIM >=0.995 or an evidence-backed explanation
standard Visual QA and inspected stereo captures show no unrelated regression
Android ARM64/Vulkan/OpenXR production build succeeds
requirements.failure_response: Revert or isolate the first unrelated dependency/change before traffic work continues.
